name: Can rental property repairs include accessibility and disability modifications?

mainEntity.name: Can rental property repairs include accessibility and disability modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, accessibility repairs and modifications are common in rental housing to accommodate tenants with mobility needs. Typical rental accessibility projects include widening interior doorways, installing safety grab bars in bathrooms, replacing high-threshold tubs with low-curb walk-in tile showers, and adding custom ramps. Working with a contractor experienced in disability modifications ensures reinforcement framing is installed securely inside walls without causing unnecessary disruption to neighboring spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Common rental modifications include grab bar backing and installation, doorway widening, ramp construction, and low-barrier shower conversions.
